verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a public REST API for creating workflows, managing event sources and handling subscriptions. It also documents a Connect REST API with TypeScript, Python and Java SDKs, a usage-records API, and REST/SSE consumption of emitted events, so the product can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the REST API, and evidence of API depth (endpoint coverage, auth model, limits) beyond overview-level statements.
